bucket.name: mlb-statcast-evidence-lock-20260802-8826086488-v1
bucket.default_retention_rule_reason: Only the two explicitly authorized object versions are in scope; accidental future objects must not inherit an unreviewed lock

encryption.decision: The evidence is public historical baseball source data. Explicit SSE-S3 provides at-rest confidentiality without introducing a customer-managed key whose disablement, policy loss or deletion could make Compliance-locked evidence unreadable.

comparison.confidentiality: S3-managed encryption at rest; sufficient for non-secret public source evidence with private bucket access
comparison.integrity_and_availability: No customer key dependency; content authority remains client SHA-256 plus read-back, not ETag
comparison.key_loss_or_deletion_risk: No customer-managed key lifecycle that can be lost or scheduled for deletion
comparison.auditability: S3 object and CloudTrail data events record the encryption response; fewer KMS events

comparison.confidentiality: Adds key-policy separation and KMS authorization boundaries
comparison.integrity_and_availability: Does not replace content SHA-256; availability additionally depends on the key remaining enabled and permitted
comparison.key_loss_or_deletion_risk: Key disablement, deletion scheduling, policy loss or grant loss can make locked bytes unreadable while they remain undeletable
comparison.auditability: Adds KMS API events and key-policy audit surface
comparison.long_term_dependency: Requires key retention at least through object retention, rotation/policy continuity, recovery ownership and deletion prevention
minimum_controls_if_later_selected: explicit deny ScheduleKeyDeletion through retention plus recovery margin
key policy bound to exact S3 roles and bucket encryption context
